tools.description: Estimating and reducing power: early estimates come from the Xilinx/AMD Power Estimator spreadsheet (XPE, per family) filled with resource counts, toggle rates and environment, importable/exportable with report_power -xpe (export design data to XPE) and read from XPE via the .xpe file; in Vivado, report_power on an implemented design combines the routed netlist with switching activity from a SAIF (read_saif from post-implementation simulation, most accurate), from set_switching_activity annotations, or from vector-less propagation with defaults (least accurate, typically pessimistic), and the environment from set_operating_conditions; report_power -advisory? the Power Constraints Advisor (report_power in the GUI > Power Constraints Advisor, or the 'Power Constraints Advisor' report) lists the signals whose activity assumptions most affect the result (resets, enables, clocks) so they can be set explicitly. Optimisation: power_opt_design (BRAM enable gating, clock-enable insertion) with set_power_opt scoping, using BRAM_POWER_OPT / cascade options (RAM_DECOMP power), clock gating with BUFGCE for idle blocks, reducing toggle in unused logic, lower I/O drive strengths and termination, DSP/BRAM sleep modes on UltraScale+ (URAM/BRAM SLEEP pins), and processor-side power management on Zynq/Versal. Sign-off: report_power -rpx for the interactive report with per-hierarchy/per-clock breakdown and the thermal margin (junction temperature vs. limit).
tools.usage:
report_power -file power.rpt -rpx power.rpx -xpe power.xpe -verbose
read_saif -strip_path tb/dut ./sim/post_route.saif
set_operating_conditions -process maximum -ambient_temp 50 -airflow 250 -heatsink medium
report_power -file power_saif.rpt
set_switching_activity -deassert_resets

tools.name: Vivado editions and licensing (ML Standard, ML Enterprise, Lab Edition; Vivado HL legacy names)
tools.description: Vivado ML Standard Edition (formerly WebPACK/HL WebPACK) is free and supports the smaller devices of each family (all Spartan-7, most Artix-7, Zynq-7000 up to XC7Z030? per the device table, Kintex-7 K70T/K160T, UltraScale+ KU3P/KU5P/ZU2-ZU7? etc., and selected Versal parts) with the full tool flow; Vivado ML Enterprise Edition is the licensed edition covering all devices and includes the ML-driven features (Intelligent Design Runs, ML strategies) and the larger UltraScale+/Versal parts; Vivado Lab Edition is free and contains only the Hardware Manager/programming/debug tools. Licenses (node-locked or floating via XILINXD_LICENSE_FILE / LM_LICENSE_FILE, FlexLM license.dat, managed in the Xilinx Product Licensing Site / AMD Account Product Licensing) are needed for Enterprise, for certain licensed IP (Ethernet MACs, HDMI, PCIe DMA in some configurations, etc.) and for evaluation cores whose hardware evaluation license times out; Vitis HLS and the Vitis Unified IDE are free, and many IP cores (AXI infrastructure, MicroBlaze, memory controllers, most DSP) are included without extra license. The Vivado License Manager (Help > Manage License) shows what is available and Tools > Report > Report IP Status flags IP license state.
tools.usage:
Help > Manage License (Vivado License Manager: set license file/server, view features)
set XILINXD_LICENSE_FILE=2100@license-server   (or LM_LICENSE_FILE)
get_ipdefs -filter {NAME =~ *hdmi*}; report_property [get_ipdefs ...] LICENSE? (see notes)
report_ip_status   ;# 'Licensed' column

parameters.name: Device support matrix
parameters.description: The Vivado release notes (UG973) table 'Device Support by Edition' lists exactly which parts are in Standard vs Enterprise per release.

parameters.name: IP license levels
parameters.description: Included, Purchase (production license required), Hardware Evaluation (timeout in hardware), Simulation Only; write_bitstream warns when an evaluation core is present.

parameters.name: Licensing server
parameters.description: FlexLM lmgrd with xilinxd daemon; port@host in XILINXD_LICENSE_FILE; 'vivado -mode batch' also needs access.

tools.example:
# Check license features from Tcl
list_features? not available; use the License Manager or
exec lmutil lmstat -a -c 2100@license-server
tools.notes: Editions renamed in 2021.1 (Vivado ML); older documents refer to Vivado HL WebPACK/Design/System Edition. Alveo/Vitis acceleration platforms are supported in both ML editions for the corresponding devices.
